brief:
Israel's far-right national security minister Itamar Ben Gvir has escalated his election campaign with inflammatory tactics, according to Al-Monitor. His team distributed gun-shaped keychains to high school students and released a promotional video threatening to "put to death" a Palestinian inmate, marking an unusually aggressive approach to Israeli electoral politics.

The campaign reflects Ben Gvir's positioning as a hardline figure willing to breach conventional political boundaries. His national security ministry role gives the effort official prominence as he prepares for upcoming elections.
dek: A turbo-charged election campaign by Israel's far-right national security minister has seen gun-shaped keychains distributed to high school students and a promotional video threatening to "put to death" a Palestinian inmate.
title: Ben Gvir wages provocative campaign ahead of Israel election
